question: Which locations of collapse or fall in the shrine structure are covered by the remedial rule?
premises: A fall may occur on the ground.
A fall may affect a limb of the structure or the whole of it.
inference: Collapse on the ground, in a part, or in the whole structure all fall under the remedial consideration.
plain_english: Whether it has fallen to the ground, or in a part of it, or in the whole of it.
